<!-- Feature Request template. Fill each section; delete guidance in parentheses. State the problem and desired outcome; leave the implementation to the maintainer. -->

## Background / Problem

(What situation are you in and what problem do you hit? How painful is it — frequency, time cost, affected users, money? Quantify where you can. Why can't the current behavior meet the need? State the problem, not a solution.)

## Desired Outcome

(What capability or effect do you want? Illustrate with one concrete use case or example of the ideal usage. Do not prescribe the implementation.)

## Acceptance Criteria

(Observable, verifiable results — not implementation. Only outcomes you own.)

- [ ] (Condition A — a user-observable behavior or effect)
- [ ] (Condition B)

## Alternatives Considered

(Workarounds you tried and why they fall short.)

## Non-Goals

(What this request explicitly does not cover, to prevent scope creep.)

## Additional Context

(Related issues/PRs, environment, constraints. Optional early ideas — mark them clearly as "for reference, not prescriptive". If you are willing to contribute a PR when accepted, say so here.)
